Cement & Concrete Index › Material prices

US construction-material prices

3,651 observations · 50 states with a state-level figure · 1990 to 2026-10 · DOT qualified lists · Data (JSON)

What's new Topics Key issues Resources Research gaps Change log Get updates Prices DOT QPLs Reactions Calculator

These rows are copied from public sources that were opened. Coverage is not exhaustive. A missing state or material means this pass did not read a figure for it.

USGS unit values are mine-gate or mill-gate averages, not delivered prices. State DOT bid prices include placement and the rest of the bid item, not the material alone. Producer price indexes are index numbers on the base printed in the row, not dollars. ENR city quotes are single-source list or transaction prices. Slag rows marked as calculated are value divided by quantity from a USGS table that does not print a unit value.

Coverage

  • Ready-mix concrete: 943
  • Concrete products: 822
  • Construction sand and gravel: 718
  • Cement: 398
  • Crushed stone: 362
  • Aggregates: 264
  • Highway construction: 122
  • Slag: 21
  • Fly ash: 1

3082 index, 283 unit value, 164 list price, 122 bid price. Geographies: city, district, national, region, state.

Trends

Charts use one national or one-state series each. They need JavaScript. The table below does not.
